about_short_description.short_description: 6sense is an account-based marketing platform that helps B2B organizations achieve predictable revenue growth.

product.name: 6sense Revenue Intelligence Platform
product.description: A B2B revenue platform that combines buyer data, predictive analytics, AI, and workflow automation for marketing and sales teams.

product.name: 6sense Revenue Marketing
product.description: A B2B marketing platform for identifying in-market accounts, building targeted audiences, running omnichannel campaigns, automating engagement, and measuring pipeline impact.

product.name: 6sense Sales Intelligence
product.description: A sales intelligence product that helps sellers find relevant accounts and contacts, prioritize buying activity, receive alerts, and act on buyer insights within sales workflows.

product.name: 6sense Signalverse
product.description: A B2B data foundation that aggregates intent, company, contact, and web activity signals to identify account research and support buyer intelligence.

product.name: 6AI
product.description: An AI layer that cleans and models account and contact data, predicts buying activity, and provides recommendations, copilots, and automated agents for revenue teams.

product.name: 6sense Predictive Modeling
product.description: A predictive analytics capability that scores accounts and forecasts buying potential using intent signals, engagement activity, and company-fit data.
